basic_details.job_title: NPC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Research Executive, Senior Professional Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Productivity Council (NPC), an autonomous body under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, has invited applications for two contractual posts at its Delhi headquarters in the Economic Services & Productivity Promotion Group: one Research Executive (Rs. 65000 per month, one year, any graduate with minimum 5 years of relevant experience) and one Senior Professional (Evaluation) (₹55,000/- per month, 06 months, Master's degree in a listed discipline). Applications go by email to [email protected] on or before 2 December 2026, by 3:00 pm.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the format of Annexure-A of the notice (name, parent's/husband's name, date of birth, addresses, Aadhaar number, contact details, email ID, post applied for, qualifications).
Fill in the Appendix, "Details of Experience" (period starting from the last, name of office/organization, post and remuneration or pay band, description of duties performed).
If you are a retired person, give the date of retirement and the name of the office where you last worked, and enclose a copy of the PPO.
Sign and date the declaration at the end of Annexure-A.
Attach self-attested copies of all requisite documents and a latest photo.
Email the application to [email protected] on or before 2 December 2026, by 3:00 pm.
Self-attested copy of proof of date of birth.
Educational/technical qualification documents, self-attested as true copies.
Copy of PPO, for a retired person.

rows.details: National Productivity Council (NPC), under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India
Research Executive: one year; Senior Professional (Evaluation): 06 months (with potential extension based on performance and project needs)
Research Executive: Rs. 65000 per month; Senior Professional (Evaluation): ₹55,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: About NPC
content_sections.text: The National Productivity Council is an autonomous body under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. According to the notice, it promotes productivity consciousness in the country for sustainable socioeconomic development through consultancy, research and training activities in different sectors of the economy. Its address is 5-6 Institutional Area, Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for two posts, one vacancy each. The notice prints no category-wise break-up. Total: 2 posts. Both are placed with the Economic Services & Productivity Promotion Group at Delhi HQ.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience. Experience in project coordination and administrative support. Experience in data management and documentation. Experience in training programme coordination and financial follow-up. Experience in government/PSU liaison and journal/publication support. 2+ years of experience preferably in evaluation, research or monitoring and evaluation (M&E) work. 1+ years of experience in hospitality management or event management (planning and conduct of conferences, workshops, seminars, exhibitions, stakeholder meets or similar events). The notice prints no age limit for either post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate in any discipline from a government recognized University or Institute
Postgraduate (Master's) degree from a recognized university in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Economics or Econometrics
rows.desirable: Familiarity with MS Office, Excel, and digital meeting platforms (Cisco WebEx etc.)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Research Executive: type of engagement is pure contract basis; contract period is one year; remuneration is Rs. 65000 per month; place of deployment is HQ, Delhi. Senior Professional (Evaluation): type of engagement is contractual; contract period is 06 months (with potential extension based on performance and project needs); remuneration is ₹55,000/- per month; place of deployment is the Economic Services & Productivity Promotion Group at Delhi HQ. Working hours, travelling and daily allowance, leave and similar matters are governed by the applicable provisions of NPC for the assignment.

content_sections.heading: NPC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The post is for undertaking day-to-day office work. The notice lists these responsibilities: Project related work such as search of new Tenders in websites, development of data entry, data entry, compiling data from secondary sources, and other support service activities for the projects. Searching author contact details from the Internet for sending article invitation letters to prospective authors for the special issues of the Productivity Journal. Co-ordination with NPC Finance Group for generation of participant fee bills and receipts. Training support activities such as liaising with participants for nomination related issues, including participation fee of training programme, on regular basis. Preparation of notes/letters in the e-office platform "Parichay". Any other work assigned by the Economic Services Group from time to time. The selected Senior Professional will be based at HQ and will contribute to the institutional electrical evaluation project and the electronics evaluation project, in support of Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) studies, data collection and analysis, surveys and reporting under government schemes in the Electrical and Electronics sector. Typical tasks may include: Evaluation of institutional electrical systems, covering power supply, energy efficiency and electrical safety standards. Evaluation of electronics goods and manufacturing processes, covering technical performance, quality and supply chain. Data collection, compilation, structuring, and database development. Economic and econometric analysis of outcomes and impact, using socio-economic indicators. Designing survey instruments, field surveys and site visits (both online/offline). Engagement with stakeholders including ministries, regional offices, and field agencies. Drafting proposals and analytical briefs. Project planning, M&E, and financial/productivity analysis. Ability to plan, coordinate, and manage conferences, workshops, seminars, exhibitions, and stakeholder meetings, including venue arrangements, logistics, hospitality, and protocol. Files management in e-office.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NPC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the format of Annexure-A of the notice (name, parent's/husband's name, date of birth, addresses, Aadhaar number, contact details, email ID, post applied for, qualifications). Fill in the Appendix, "Details of Experience" (period starting from the last, name of office/organization, post and remuneration or pay band, description of duties performed). If you are a retired person, give the date of retirement and the name of the office where you last worked, and enclose a copy of the PPO. Sign and date the declaration at the end of Annexure-A. Attach self-attested copies of all requisite documents and a latest photo. Email the application to [email protected] on or before 2 December 2026, by 3:00 pm. Self-attested copy of proof of date of birth. Self-attested copy of Aadhaar. Educational/technical qualification documents, self-attested as true copies. Duly filled Appendix (Details of Experience). Copy of PPO, for a retired person. Latest photo.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Research Executive (ES/01) and one Senior Professional (Evaluation) (ES/02), both on contract at Delhi HQ.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application must be sent on or before 2 December 2026, by 3:00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Research Executive post?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a graduate in any discipline from a government recognized University or Institute, with minimum 5 years of relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Senior Professional (Evaluation) post?
faq.answer: A Postgraduate (Master's) degree from a recognized university in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Economics or Econometrics is the minimum. Experience of 2+ years, preferably in evaluation, research or M&E work, and 1+ years in hospitality or event management are also listed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary under NPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Research Executive gets Rs. 65000 per month and the Senior Professional (Evaluation) gets ₹55,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for NPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application as per Annexure-A and the Appendix, with self-attested copies of all requisite documents and a latest photo, by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Is the NPC job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The Research Executive is engaged on a pure contract basis for one year. The Senior Professional (Evaluation) is engaged for 06 months, with potential extension based on performance and project needs. The engagement gives no right to regular appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidates work?
faq.answer: Both posts are placed at HQ, Delhi, in the Economic Services & Productivity Promotion Group.

faq.question: Q9. What documents must be produced at joining?
faq.answer: Original documents and certificates in support of age, qualification and experience must be produced at the time of joining. Otherwise the offer of engagement stands withdrawn.
